create_L1Loss: create an L1Loss module to compute mean absolute error between predictions and targets
create_L2Loss: create an L2Loss module to compute mean squared error between predictions and targets
create_TripletLoss: create a TripletLoss module with margin to enforce anchor-positive distance smaller than anchor-negative distance
create_CELoss: create a CELoss module to compute cross-entropy loss between predictions and target classes
create_BCEWithLogitsLoss: create a BCEWithLogitsLoss module to compute binary cross-entropy with logits for classification
